decisions.reason: The firm has invested in a multi-model product line with nearly 200 agency templates, it fits the compliance direction the firm has announced, and the positive customer feedback gives management every reason to persist.

As the flagship featured on the home page and central to the agency-platform direction, the platform carries heavy investment and public commitment, so any weak results would be treated as early-stage and temporary.

The configurable plan sits close to the core hosting offer, is cheap to maintain on the owned container infrastructure, and supports the scalable-hosting promise, so there is no compelling reason to withdraw it.
